articles.image_title: Digitales: AUCKLAND, NEW ZEALAND - NOVEMBER 19: In this photo illustration, young children hold an iPhone while using the online game platform Roblox on November 19, 2025 in Auckland, New Zealand. Roblox will block in-game chat for users under 13 unless they complete mandatory age verification, tightening safety controls across the platform. The changes will take effect in Australia, New Zealand and the Netherlands in December, and the rest of the world in January, 2026. (Photo illustration by Getty Images)
